sources.finding: Final 26–3, regulation. Both starting QBs played every offensive snap; all primary specialists served. Montgomery replaced by Marks. Flott injured Q2 7:47, returned 5:09, tackled at 3:57, questionable Q3 12:58 and out Q4 14:09. Pitre injured Q4 12:21 with no return; Stingley injured 12:06, returned 11:52. Final active starters, reserves, inactive/DNP and snap tables establish the named duty inventory.
Final report: Dell and Braden Smith out; Hooker out, Martin-Robinson questionable and inactive; other listed questionable Texans active. Nathan Thomas illness cleared.
Both final inactive lists distinguish injury absences and healthy scratches.

Dated reserve, release and activation chronology reviewed. Higgins Aug21; Dell/Ingram/Gaye/Speed Aug30; Braden Smith Sept1; Henry Sept15; Hummel Sept26; Edwards Sept30; Brooks Oct2; Jaylin Oct6. Braden activated Oct14, Henry/Ingram Oct17, after this game.
Reserve placements: Harrell/Kanak Aug16; Eifler Aug24; Brooks/Kpassagnon/Mausi/Williams Aug30–31; Carmona/Slater Sept29. Oliver elevated Oct10; Joshua Williams activated Oct17, after Week5.
Current reserve inventory cross-checked with dated moves so later activations do not erase earlier absences.
Reserve inventory reconciled with dated transactions and final game-day inactive/DNP inventory.
Published depth supports Adams behind Hooker, Burgess behind Winston, and Robinson at corner. Snapshot observed after game; final gamebook independently confirms actual available occupants.
Winston developed quad tightness during pregame warmups and did not play any snaps. Use a full-game absence rather than the later questionable announcement as an injury start.
Oliver elevated for Week5; veteran defensive back previously played cornerback before moving to safety. Supports available secondary reserve capacity, not an observed Williams substitution.
Houston promoted linebacker Jamal Hill following Henry Tootoo IR placement; source identifies depth role and prior special-teams participation.
Speed season absence leaves Hansen and Tootoo as expected primary outside linebackers. Tootoo subsequent injury is separately retained, with distinct Hill reserve allocation.
Higgins expected an important 2026 role after prior regular-season production; Hutchinson and Noel among named successors. Continuing Dell absence retained separately.
Byrd had one regular-season appearance in 2024, so he is included rather than excluded as a camp-only player.
Ossai 2025 regular-season games zero; developmental role assessment checked separately from preseason appearances.
Rutgers reports Hamilton missed his 2025 rookie season on injured reserve after training-camp injury. No established regular-season role before this continuing developmental reserve absence.
